en.display_text:
Consider the following statements about specific programs and instruments of the Islamic Development Bank:

1. The Reverse Linkage program of the Islamic Development Bank facilitates knowledge and technology transfer exclusively in the direction of Gulf states receiving expertise from Southeast Asian OIC members — reflecting the latter's more advanced Islamic finance infrastructure.
2. IsDB uniquely integrates Waqf (Islamic endowment) management into development financing through the Awqaf Properties Investment Fund (APIF), a feature absent in all other major multilateral development banks.
3. The Islamic Solidarity Fund for Development (ISFD) is an IsDB instrument designed exclusively for post-natural-disaster reconstruction in member states and cannot be deployed for pre-emptive poverty reduction programs.

Which of the above statements is/are NOT correct?

(a) 2 only
(b) 1 only
(c) 2 and 3 only
(d) 1 and 3 only

statement_analysis.statement: The Reverse Linkage program of the Islamic Development Bank facilitates knowledge and technology transfer exclusively in the direction of Gulf states receiving expertise from Southeast Asian OIC members — reflecting the latter's more advanced Islamic finance infrastructure.
statement_analysis.reason: Reverse Linkage is not unidirectional toward Gulf states. The mechanism enables more advanced OIC members (which include Gulf states, Turkey, Malaysia, and others) to share with less advanced members. The description reverses the intended direction and incorrectly restricts it to Gulf state recipients.

statement_analysis.statement: IsDB uniquely integrates Waqf (Islamic endowment) management into development financing through the Awqaf Properties Investment Fund (APIF), a feature absent in all other major multilateral development banks.
statement_analysis.reason: This is accurate. APIF is a real IsDB Group instrument for Waqf-based development finance, and no other major MDB has an equivalent. This statement is correctly characterised.

statement_analysis.statement: The Islamic Solidarity Fund for Development (ISFD) is an IsDB instrument designed exclusively for post-natural-disaster reconstruction in member states and cannot be deployed for pre-emptive poverty reduction programs.
statement_analysis.reason: ISFD targets both poverty alleviation and crisis response — it is not limited to post-disaster reconstruction. The 'exclusively' and 'cannot be deployed for poverty reduction' characterisations are fabricated restrictions.

en.strong_distractor: b — Students may mark only Statement 1 as 'not correct' (catching the directional error) while accepting Statement 3's 'disaster reconstruction only' restriction as plausible for a solidarity fund, and marking Statement 2 as the answer.
elimination_logic: Statement 1: Claims Reverse Linkage flows exclusively toward Gulf states from Southeast Asia — this reverses both the direction (flows from more to less advanced members) and misidentifies the recipients. Mark NOT correct.
Statement 2: APIF as IsDB's Waqf management instrument with no MDB equivalent — this is accurate. Mark correct (not the answer to 'NOT correct').

Statement 3: ISFD described as 'exclusively for post-natural-disaster reconstruction' and 'cannot be used for poverty reduction' — ISFD explicitly targets poverty alleviation alongside crisis response. Mark NOT correct.
Statements 1 and 3 are NOT correct — answer is (d).
en.upsc_trap_explanation: Statement 3's plausible-fabrication trap creates a credible-sounding restriction for a 'Solidarity Fund' — it sounds logical that a solidarity fund would be reactive (post-disaster) rather than proactive (poverty reduction). Students unfamiliar with ISFD's specific mandate may accept this restriction. The correct understanding is that ISFD covers both poverty alleviation and crisis response, making it broader than the 'disaster only' characterisation.
en.final_explanation:
Understanding precise program mandates within IsDB is essential for distinguishing correct from plausible-sounding descriptions.

• Statement 1 — NOT Correct: Reverse Linkage does not flow exclusively toward Gulf states from Southeast Asia. It facilitates knowledge transfer from more advanced to less advanced OIC member states — the directionality and recipient identification in this statement are both wrong. Gulf states and Malaysia/Turkey are often providers, while African OIC members are often recipients.
• Statement 2 — Correct: APIF (Awqaf Properties Investment Fund) is a genuine IsDB instrument for Waqf-based development finance with no MDB equivalent. This statement is accurate.
• Statement 3 — NOT Correct: ISFD is NOT restricted to post-natural-disaster reconstruction. It targets poverty alleviation and crisis response broadly — including pre-emptive development programs for the poorest OIC members.

Value Addition:
• Reverse Linkage examples: Malaysia → African OIC states (Islamic finance expertise); Turkey → OIC states (healthcare).
• ISFD was established in 2007 with contributions from OIC member states as an Islamic solidarity instrument.
• APIF generates development finance from the commercial management of Islamic endowment (Waqf) properties globally.

hi.display_text:
इस्लामिक डेवलपमेंट बैंक के विशिष्ट कार्यक्रमों और उपकरणों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. इस्लामिक डेवलपमेंट बैंक का रिवर्स लिंकज कार्यक्रम ज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी के स्थानांतरण को केवल खाड़ी देशों की ओर सक्षम बनाता है, जो दक्षिण-पूर्व एशियाई OIC सदस्यों से विशेषज्ञता प्राप्त करते हैं — जो बाद वाले के अधिक उन्नत इस्लामी वित्तीय ढांचे को दर्शाता है।
2. IsDB विशिष्ट रूप से अवकाफ (इस्लामी धरोहर) प्रबंधन को अवकाफ प्रॉपर्टीज़ इन्वेस्टमेंट फंड (APIF) के माध्यम से विकास वित्तपोषण में एकीकृत करता है, जो सभी अन्य प्रमुख बहुपक्षीय विकास बैंकों में अनुपस्थित है।
3. इस्लामिक सॉलिडैरिटी फंड फॉर डेवलपमेंट (ISFD) एक IsDB उपकरण है जो केवल सदस्य राज्यों में प्राकृतिक आपदा के बाद पुनर्निर्माण के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है और इसे पूर्व-सक्रिय गरीबी उन्मूलन कार्यक्रमों के लिए लागू नहीं किया जा सकता।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही नहीं है/हैं?

(a) केवल 2
(b) केवल 1
